answer: An agent exchange buys wharf traffic reports, zenith-angle forecasts and knoll surveys. It assigns each task a fixed bounty and pays only once for a verified result, regardless of how many accounts submit it. Agents commit a result hash before seeing competing submissions; an independent checker tests the evidence before payment. There are no per-account signup rewards. A Sybil operator gains nothing by copying one report into a thousand identities and must produce additional valid, separately requested work to earn more. Checker independence is essential.
